description: Requests and the toolkit skill an assistant should load first. Run with python3 scripts/run_routing_evals.py; see evals/README.md.

cases.prompt: Does this sentence agree with the published evidence? 'Sodium absorption in the atmosphere of HD 209458 b was first detected by Charbonneau et al. in 2002 with HST/STIS.'
Find recent papers that compare atmospheric retrieval codes for exoplanet transmission spectra and summarise where their conclusions agree.
How does numpy.random.Generator derive independent streams from a SeedSequence? Check the official docs and source and write me a note.
Which arguments does matplotlib's savefig accept for embedding PDF metadata? Look it up in the documentation and source code.
I'm about to train the same classifier with 12 different hyperparameter settings. Set things up so that I can later tell exactly which code, data split and settings produced each reported score.
We run our RNA-seq processing pipeline on each new sequencing batch. Make sure every batch's outputs record the pipeline version, reference genome, parameters and environment used.
I'm about to launch a sweep of 40 simulations over two model parameters. Set things up so every output can be traced back to the configuration and code that made it.
Rerun the analysis behind Figure 3 of our paper from this repository and tell me whether the plotted values still match the published ones.
Is a Reynolds number of 3e7 plausible for blood flow in a capillary? Sanity check the units too.
Before I fit a model, profile data/measurements.csv for missing values, outliers and possible leakage between the train and test splits.
Make my matplotlib light-curve figure publication-ready for a journal, colour-blind safe and with honest error bars.
This abstract sounds like it was written by an AI. Edit it to be more direct without changing the scientific claims.
Write the pull request description for the changes on my current branch.
Audit this repository for dead code, unnecessary complexity and duplication, and give me a prioritised cleanup plan without changing files.
